entity.summary: LLCs, corporations and other entities are formed with the Kentucky Secretary of State, mostly online. If you'll do business under a name other than your exact legal name, file a certificate of assumed name (DBA).
entity.quote: If you decide to form an entity, you can complete most filings online through this website.

state_tax.summary: Register for state tax accounts (sales and use tax, employer payroll withholding) with the Kentucky Tax Registration Application on MyTaxes.ky.gov.
state_tax.quote: The Kentucky Tax Registration Application allows new businesses or those starting new taxable activities to register for tax accounts.

unemployment.agency: Kentucky Office of Unemployment Insurance (Kentucky Career Center)
unemployment.summary: Liable employers open an Employer Reserve Account through Kentucky's Unemployment Insurance Self-Service site.
unemployment.quote: Apply for an Employer Reserve Account, including for an acquisition or purchase of an existing business;

workers_comp.summary: Any business (other than agriculture) with one or more employees in Kentucky must carry workers' compensation. State-licensed electricians, plumbers and HVAC contractors must also show proof of workers' comp to get licensed.
workers_comp.quote: Any person, other than one engaged solely in agriculture, that has in this state one (1) or more employees subject to this chapter.

local.summary: After forming your business, also register with county and city governments as needed; many Kentucky cities and counties charge occupational license fees.
local.quote: Register with other State, County, and Local Governments as appropriate for your business.

residential_building.covers: General and remodeling contractors; any licensing is local.
residential_building.summary: Kentucky does not issue a state general or residential contractor license. Check with the city and county where you work for any local license or registration.
residential_building.quote: Register with other State, County, and Local Governments as appropriate for your business.
residential_building.note: No state statute or agency page creating a general/residential contractor license was found; the state Department of Housing, Buildings and Construction licenses electrical, plumbing, HVAC, fire sprinkler and elevator trades only. The quote supports checking local requirements, not the absence of a state license itself.

commercial_building.covers: Commercial general contractors; any licensing is local.
commercial_building.summary: There is no state commercial general contractor license in Kentucky; check local requirements.
commercial_building.quote: Register with other State, County, and Local Governments as appropriate for your business.
commercial_building.note: Same as residential: absence of a state license is inferred from the state's licensing statutes, not stated on one official page.

electrical.name: Electrical Contractor, Master Electrician, Electrician licenses
electrical.agency: KY Dept. of Housing, Buildings and Construction (DHBC)
electrical.covers: Electrical contracting businesses and the electricians doing the work.
prerequisites: Contractor: hold or employ a Kentucky master electrician
Contractor: pass the Business and Law exam
Contractor: general liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 plus workers' comp and unemployment insurance compliance
Master electrician: 16,000 hours of experience since age sixteen and pass the master exam
Electrician: 8,000 hours of experience since age sixteen and pass the journeyman exam
electrical.insurance: General liability of not less than $1,000,000; workers' comp (or a notarized waiver for sole proprietors with no employees)
electrical.summary: Kentucky licenses electrical contractors, master electricians and electricians. A contractor must be or employ a master electrician, pass a business and law exam, and carry at least $1,000,000 in general liability insurance.
electrical.quote: In order to apply for your electrical contractor’s license, you will need a Kentucky master electrician license or employ a Kentucky licensed master electrician.
electrical.note: Approved training, apprenticeship or a degree can substitute for some of the experience hours.

evidence.quote: Send a copy of your passing test results for Business and Law Exam with PROV or Pearson Vue.

Has submitted proof that he or she has complied with workers' compensation and unemployment insurance laws and administrative regulations and has obtained a general liability insurance policy of not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000).
Proof of experience totaling 16,000 hours in the electrical trade since your sixteenth birthday.
Proof of experience totaling 8,000 hours in the electrical trade since your sixteenth birthday.
If you do not have employees, you may submit a notarized workers compensation waiver. It must state you are the sole proprietor and have no employees.

plumbing.name: Master Plumber and Journeyman Plumber licenses
plumbing.agency: KY Dept. of Housing, Buildings and Construction (DHBC)
plumbing.covers: Anyone doing plumbing work; a plumbing business must be run under an active master plumber license.
prerequisites: Journeyman: two consecutive years as an apprentice plumber (or an approved course plus one year) and pass the state exam
Master: journeyman license held two years within the past five years, plus two years under a master, and pass the master exam
General liability insurance of not less than $250,000 and workers' comp/unemployment compliance
plumbing.insurance: General liability of not less than $250,000, plus proof of workers' comp and unemployment insurance compliance
plumbing.summary: Kentucky requires a state master or journeyman plumber license to do plumbing. To get the active master license that a plumbing business operates under, you need journeyman experience, a passing exam score and at least $250,000 in liability insurance.
plumbing.quote: No person shall engage in plumbing or engage in or work at the trade of plumbing: (a) Unless he or she is the holder of a valid and effective active master plumber's license

evidence.quote: maintains general liability insurance in an amount not less than two hundred fifty thousand dollars ($250,000) and submits proof of compliance with workers' compensation and unemployment insurance laws

Have held a valid journeyman plumber's license for a minimum of two (2) years within the past five (5) years immediately preceding application and be actively employed in plumbing under the supervision of a licensed master plumber for a minimum of two (2) years
At least two (2) consecutive years of experience as an apprentice plumber
Complete a department approved course that includes content on the practice of plumbing or the Kentucky State Plumbing Code and at least one (1) year of experience as an apprentice plumber.

mechanical.name: Master HVAC Contractor and Journeyman HVAC Mechanic licenses
mechanical.agency: KY Dept. of Housing, Buildings and Construction (DHBC)
mechanical.covers: Heating, ventilation and air conditioning contracting.
prerequisites: Master HVAC contractor: be at least 18
Master: two years as a journeyman under a master HVAC contractor (or two years as a master elsewhere, or as a licensed mechanical engineer)
General liability insurance of not less than $500,000 and property damage insurance of not less than $300,000
mechanical.insurance: General liability of not less than $500,000 and property damage of not less than $300,000
mechanical.summary: Kentucky licenses HVAC contractors and mechanics. A master HVAC contractor needs two years as a journeyman under a master, a passing exam, and liability and property damage insurance.
mechanical.quote: Have been regularly and principally employed or engaged in heating, ventilation, and air conditioning trades as a journeyman heating, ventilation, and air conditioning mechanic for not less than two (2) years under the direction and supervision of a master heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contractor;

evidence.quote: Be at least eighteen (18) years of age;
Have passed an examination prescribed by the department to determine the applicant's competency to practice heating, ventilation, and air conditioning contracting
general liability insurance in an amount not less than five hundred thousand dollars ($500,000) and property damage insurance in an amount not less than three hundred thousand dollars ($300,000)

roofing.covers: Roofing contractors; any licensing is local.
roofing.summary: Kentucky has no state roofing license; check local city and county requirements.
roofing.quote: Register with other State, County, and Local Governments as appropriate for your business.
roofing.note: No state roofing licensing statute was found; absence is inferred, not stated on an official page.

pesticide.name: Pesticide Operator's License (lawn/ornamental, etc.); Structural Pest Management License
pesticide.covers: Businesses applying pesticides to other people's land (lawn care, weed control) and anyone doing structural pest control or fumigation.
prerequisites: Valid applicator certification in the category (exam)
Registered as a dealer or employed by a registered dealer
Surety bond or liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 for dealers applying pesticides to others' land
pesticide.bond: Surety bond or liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000
pesticide.insurance: Liability insurance of not less than $1,000,000 (alternative to bond)
pesticide.summary: A lawn-spraying or pest control business needs a Kentucky Department of Agriculture license: an operator's license backed by certification for lawn and land applications, or a structural pest management license for pest control. The business must carry a $1,000,000 bond or liability insurance.
pesticide.quote: No person shall engage in the business of applying pesticides to the lands of another within this state at any time without a pesticide operator's license issued by the department.
pesticide.note: The Department of Agriculture's own site (www.kyagr.com) is not on a .gov host, so statutes are cited.

evidence.quote: No license shall be issued unless the applicant holds a valid certification within this category.
No license shall be issued unless the applicant is registered as a dealer or is employed by a person who is registered as a dealer.

No person shall engage in structural pest management or structural fumigation without first obtaining a license from the department certifying competence to make commercial or noncommercial pesticide applications.
The amount of the surety bond or liability insurance as provided for in this section shall be not less than one million dollars ($1,000,000).

asbestos.name: Asbestos abatement entity certificate (and individual accreditation)
asbestos.agency: Kentucky Energy and Environment Cabinet, Division for Air Quality
asbestos.covers: Businesses doing regulated asbestos abatement projects.
prerequisites: Complete the required asbestos training before applying
Pass a compliance demonstration on an abatement project
asbestos.summary: An asbestos abatement business needs a certificate from the Energy and Environment Cabinet before doing regulated abatement work. Training must be completed before applying.
asbestos.quote: A certificate to engage in an asbestos abatement project has been issued by the cabinet in accordance with this administrative regulation and is currently in effect.

evidence.quote: An asbestos abatement entity shall not be considered for certification unless the training requirements of Section 10 of this administrative regulation have been completed prior to application.
including its approval or denial, within thirty (30) days after attendance at the asbestos abatement project demonstration

lead_rrp.name: EPA RRP Firm Certification and Certified Renovator
lead_rrp.covers: Paid renovation, repair and painting in pre-1978 housing and child-occupied facilities.
lead_rrp.summary: Kentucky is not authorized to run its own lead renovation program, so firms get RRP certification directly from EPA and use EPA-certified renovators for work on homes built before 1978.
lead_rrp.quote: EPA's renovation program applies to all states, Tribes and territories where EPA has not specifically provided authorization for that state, Tribe or territory to operate the program themselves.

evidence.quote: Federal law requires all renovation, repair, and painting firms (including sole proprietorships) working in housing, or facilities where children are routinely present, built before 1978, to be certified.

EPA administers the RRP Program in most Tribes, states and territories, but has authorized the following to operate their own programs: Alabama, Delaware, Georgia, Iowa, Kansas, Massachusetts, Mississippi, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Oregon, Rhode Island, Utah, Vermont, Washington, Wisconsin

other.name: Fire Protection Sprinkler Contractor License/Certificate
other.agency: KY Dept. of Housing, Buildings and Construction (DHBC)
other.summary: Installing, repairing or inspecting fire sprinkler systems requires a state fire protection sprinkler contractor license or certificate.
other.quote: no person other than a certificate holder or an employee of a certificate holder shall engage in the preparation of technical drawings, installation, repair, alteration, extension, maintenance or inspection of a fire protection sprinkler system
